# innoscripta

> innoscripta specializes in German R&D tax allowance optimization, providing audit-ready documentation software and compliance solutions to help companies secure up to €3.5M in annual research funding.

innoscripta offers integrated software modules for R&D documentation, time tracking, project management, and HR administration designed specifically for German Research Allowance (Forschungszulage) compliance. The platform helps companies across manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, biotech, and other innovation-heavy industries maximize tax benefits while maintaining audit-ready records.

## Key Topics

- Research Allowance (Forschungszulage)
- R&D Tax Incentives
- Audit-Ready Documentation
- GoBD Compliance
- Time Tracking
- Project Management
- Tax Savings
- R&D Funding
- Innovation Funding
- German Tax Benefits
- HR Management
- Compliance Reporting
- BSFZ
- BMF Guidelines
- Multi-Entity R&D Oversight

## Core Products

- [R&D Documentation Software: Audit-Ready & Compliant](https://www.innoscripta.com/en/products): Main product overview: audit-ready R&D documentation and compliance software
- [R&D Time Tracking Software: Audit-Ready Time Records](https://www.innoscripta.com/en/products/time-tracking): Time tracking module: audit-ready records, activity documentation, statistics
- [R&D Task Management Software: For Agile Project Management](https://www.innoscripta.com/en/products/task-management): Task management for agile R&D: sprint planning, time tracking, compliance
- [R&D Project Management Software: Drive Innovation](https://www.innoscripta.com/en/products/project-management): Project management module: dashboards, resource planning, cost management
- [HR Software: Personnel Management for R&D Funding](https://www.innoscripta.com/en/products/human-resources): HR module for R&D funding: salary, team management, employee allocation
- [R&D Stakeholder Software: Global Multi Entity R&D Oversight](https://www.innoscripta.com/en/products/shareholders): Multi-entity R&D oversight: shareholder tracking, subsidy management
